title: This book’s writing year
scope: Local manuscript-save events for this book only. No other novels are scanned, and no data enters AI context.
emptyTitle: No saved events for this year yet
emptyHelp: Save manuscript changes in the editor to see recorded net changes here. Earlier writing history is never invented.
writingDayRule: A day counts only when its total saved net change is positive
withinYear: Consecutive days within the selected year only
hourRule: Grouped by the hour of saved events (UTC+08:00), never writing duration.
calendarHelp: One cell per day. Darker means a larger increase; hatching marks a net decrease. Hover for date and net change.
monthlyRule: Month and hour charts show saved net changes across all sources. Manual, accepted AI, restore and unknown sources stay separate above; none is labelled original authorship.
negativeLegend: Teal: increase; gold: decrease. Deleting repetitive prose is recorded honestly, too.
catalogRule: Volumes and chapters use today’s catalog and include revision saves. Save counts are not editing time or proof of completion in that year. Unmapped historical chapters remain unassigned.
unassigned: {{count}} historical saves could not be mapped to a current chapter. They remain in annual source totals.
sharePrivacy: The PNG uses only aggregate figures and the pen name / book title you enter below. It excludes project paths, stored project names, manuscript, journal and settings. No network request.
canvasUnavailable: Image generation is unavailable here. The full local report remains readable.
shareBasis: Novel Studio · Saved manuscript deltas · Generated locally
method: Only recorded Han-character differences before and after manuscript saves are aggregated. Deletions are negative; repeated saves are zero. Old external estimates, invalid and future events are excluded. No writing duration is measured or inferred.
legacy: Includes {{count}} valid legacy saved events without a method marker, preserving the existing compatibility rule.
omittedUnknown: Unknown historical completion dates, author identity and writing duration are never guessed.
sourceShare: Manual vs accepted AI: additions share
sourceShareBasis: Computed from positive saved deltas for these two sources separately. Deletions remain reflected above; restoration and unknown sources are excluded. This is not a measure of originality.
sourceShareEmpty: No attributable positive saved deltas yet; no percentage is inferred.
incompleteCore: The report’s core source figures could not be verified. Refresh to retry; missing records are never converted into zeroes.
partialData: Some supporting data is unavailable: {{sections}}. Verified totals remain, with no invented chart values.
chartUnavailable: These records are unavailable. No estimated chart is drawn.
sharePartial: Some chart records are unavailable · No invented values
